data.body: ESCALATED tier — 3-way convergence (score=2) from Web/History/Code-Tracer lenses. Unified root cause: verify-session-provenance.sh:425 walk-loop silently fails when DSO_BASE_SHA or DSO_SESSION_HEAD is unreachable in shallow clone (depth=1 + actions/checkout fetches only refs/pull/N/merge, NOT pull_request.head.sha). git log $base..$head exits 128, 2>/dev/null suppresses the error, while-loop runs 0 iters, script falls through to All commits provenanced exit 0. A1-A4 filter logic is DEAD CODE in this failure mode. CI smoking gun: wrapper invocation 40ms with 0 API calls; empty covered-list; DSO_SESSION_HEAD=c7b0ad3855 not in shallow clone. The inline shell at ci.yml Verify session provenance step has a git rev-parse --verify guard for this exact case — but only on the FIRST invocation, not the wrappers. Empirical Agent dispatched to validate. Previous fix attempts PR #259/PR #260 patched filter logic that the failure path never reaches.
